title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for history of colon cancer.

HPI
Pt is a 66-year-old female presenting for routine surveillance. Hx of colon cancer. Primary malignancy was surgically removed and treated several years ago. Treatment is complete. Pt reports feeling well with no new symptoms. No current issues noted.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily.

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F.
Physical: CTAB. RRR. Abd soft, non-tender, non-distended. No masses. WNL.

Assessment
1. History of colon cancer. Stable. Primary site shows no evidence of local recurrence. No evidence of disease in other sites.

Plan
1. Continue routine surveillance.
2. Pt to f/u in 6 months for monitoring.
3. No active treatment indicated at this time.

Electronically signed, J. Lindqvist, MD, 10/14/2026
explanations: The colon cancer was excised or eradicated, no treatment is directed to it and there is no evidence of it: personal history Z85.038 (no HCC). Any metastasis is still coded as a current secondary malignancy.

distractors.why: Treatment ended and there is no evidence of the primary: code personal history (Z85), not active cancer.
